title: Trails carved into the woods, snow guns running
notes: The planted resort of shot 06 (density 7 Forest, Spruce) after the calendar move: all 4 lifts built, guns switched on for every run (331 guns in the area), the natural snow melted at 18 C, then -8 C until the runs held a 0.96 m pack. Close the hub first: the piste map draws only while the hub is open. The camera stands about 300 m above the valley floor (ground about 596) west of the area and looks east-southeast across the trails; a lateral dolly of about 130 m with a 16 m descent. Takes: t1 Time of Day 15.9 (dusk), t2 16.4 (blue hour), t3 12 (day). The first Photo Mode still after a camera jump comes out overexposed: settle with two stills before recording.
